notes: Independently read all 64 eligible production JS/TS-family files (8,203 lines), including three .boundary-stubs declaration files, all local API/setup/policy barrels, lazy capability factories, and src helpers; reviewed package.json and the complete manifest separately. All 117 plugin files are partitioned into 66 reviewed and 51 excluded records.

Production source and plugin metadata match pinned commit d912f0c06e7af29a4a40c4211bec0bb76d473f10. Root/extensions/SDK instructions were read, plus src/plugins instructions for public API context types. SDK contract files are provenance references, not additional plugin-owned source.

Every local import remains inside extensions/xai (src ../ imports target its parent plugin root). No additional shared shipped source crosses the plugin boundary. The declared typebox/ws packages and ws-runtime.ts require.resolve("ws/package.json") stay installed-dependency boundaries and are not recursively audited.

Public package exports and SDK facade declarations verify all 46 imported SDK subpaths. Original public export names are retained for local aliases: OPENCLAW_VERSION as PACKAGE_VERSION, normalizeOptionalString as trimString/trimToUndefined, and asOptionalObjectRecord as readXaiObjectRecord.

index.ts provider(pluginApi) and register(api) callbacks are typed by defineSingleProviderPluginEntry as OpenClawPluginApi; setup-api.ts uses definePluginEntry. Only explicit registration calls and pluginApi.runtime.version contribute API/runtime findings. Registration performed inside SDK entry helpers and replay-family helper effects are not expanded.

ProviderAuthContext.runtime is RuntimeEnv (src/plugins/provider-authentication.types.ts), not PluginRuntime, so xai-oauth.ts ctx.runtime.log does not contribute runtime-member findings. Provider/model/tool/setup/voice contexts, req/config objects, the stream.ts clientVersion container, and XaiTranscriptionRuntime (Pick<PluginCapabilityCatalogHostContext, ...>) likewise are not API/runtime handles.

capability-provider-metadata.ts, lazy-capability-providers.ts and speech-provider-metadata.ts inject unchanged imported SDK auth/agent-scope functions into local factory contexts. Proven local calls retain the original SDK-export identities; destructured parameter selections contribute member-access. Explicit literal Pick selections of those proven SDK-valued context fields contribute type-reference, making the four auth/agent-scope export identities mixed. Neither whole context types nor downstream uses of projected aliases expand every possible property; no SDK-module import is inferred from a later type-reference.

realtime-voice-bridge.ts preserves the proxy-capture namespace #* import. Separately narrowed named exports record the observed calls or captureWsEventAsync member read; no named import syntax is invented. Constructors count as call; RealtimeVoiceWebSocketTransport also has an explicit type annotation and is mixed.

stream.ts underlying = baseStreamFn ?? streamSimple preserves a direct callable fallback alias. createPlainTextToolCallCompatWrapper is only imported and passed to composeProviderStreamWrappers; no call is inferred inside the SDK helper. Objects returned by SDK helpers and class instances do not become public API/runtime handles.

Local api.ts/setup/capability/metadata reexports forward plugin-owned implementations or constants rather than SDK exports. No SDK reexport, hook registration, opaque runtime escape, or genuinely nonstatic SDK dependency remains unresolved.

Manifest findings include providers and every contracts item only: descriptive categories, capability/doctor/setup/model-catalog/endpoint/config/toolMetadata fields are not extra contract identities. Source dependencies include explicit type syntax; the actual published artifact has not been enumerated.

Test support exclusions were verified through repository-wide caller searches. The three declaration stubs are retained as eligible source with zero SDK findings; they contain only local declarations and no SDK dependencies.

Source-only reconciliation: exact typeof plus unchanged host assignment proves the injected createRealtimeTranscriptionWebSocketSession function. Per the frozen focused-facade convention, its identity is openclaw/plugin-sdk/realtime-transcription-session#createRealtimeTranscriptionWebSocketSession with call and type-reference; no implicit import or runtime-member is invented. The selected resolveApiKeyForProvider host field is a forwarding wrapper (src/plugins/capability-catalog-context.ts:37-42), so it does not acquire the separately imported SDK function identity.

Reads of this.audioFormat at lines 119 and 175 add member-access to the original constant export.
